acceptance_criteria: all 101 stable requirement IDs remain present
every requirement has an allowed terminal disposition

may: set the objective phase to COMPLETE
may_not: modify the specification, policy, objective history, source, tests, docs, or sibling repositories
deploy, merge, push, or create a PR

deterministic_command: import{readFileSync}from'node:fs';import{readJson}from'./src/io.js';import{setRequirements,updateState}from'./src/state.js';const root=process.cwd();const manifest=readJson('.opsle/final-reconciliation.json');const matrix=readJson('.opsle/requirements.json');const exceptions=new Set([...manifest.deferred,...manifest.not_applicable].map(x=>x.id));for(const item of matrix.requirements){if(!exceptions.has(item.id))setRequirements(root,[item.id],'VERIFIED',manifest.verified_evidence)}for(const item of manifest.deferred)setRequirements(root,[item.id],'DEFERRED_WITH_JUSTIFICATION',manifest.verified_evidence,item.justification);for(const item of manifest.not_applicable)setRequirements(root,[item.id],'NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_JUSTIFICATION',manifest.verified_evidence,item.justification);updateState(root,{phase:'COMPLETE',pending_next_action:'Objective complete; remain inspectable and await operator direction.'})
expected_deliverable: Exactly 97 VERIFIED, 2 DEFERRED_WITH_JUSTIFICATION, 2 NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_JUSTIFICATION, and zero unaccounted requirements.
expected_evidence: durable evidence references on every VERIFIED entry
explicit justification on every deferred or not-applicable entry
objective: Deterministically apply the supervisor-reviewed DS-000 through DS-100 disposition manifest and prove zero unaccounted requirements.
relevant_context: The reconciliation manifest was reviewed by the authoritative supervisor after full verification and recovery proof
title: Apply the final requirements reconciliation
